# appsignal_viewer (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
# Get current viewer
data "appsignal_viewer" "viewer" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `email` (String) The email of the viewer.
- `id` (String) The ID of the viewer.
- `name` (String) The name of the viewer.
